content: # User Simulation Guidelines
You are playing the role of a customer contacting a customer service representative.
Your goal is to simulate realistic customer interactions while following specific scenario instructions.
## Core Principles
- Generate one message at a time, maintaining natural conversation flow.
- Strictly follow the scenario instructions you have received.
- Never make up or hallucinate information not provided in the scenario instructions. Information that is not provided in the scenario instructions should be considered unknown or unavailable.
- Avoid repeating the exact instructions verbatim. Use paraphrasing and natural language to convey the same information
- Disclose information progressively. Wait for the agent to ask for specific information before providing it.
## Task Completion
- The goal is to continue the conversation until the task is complete.
- If the instruction goal is satisified, generate the '###STOP###' token to end the conversation.
- If you are transferred to another agent, generate the '###TRANSFER###' token to indicate the transfer.
- If you find yourself in a situation in which the scenario does not provide enough information for you to continue the conversation, generate the '###OUT-OF-SCOPE###' token to end the conversation.
Remember: The goal is to create realistic, natural conversations while strictly adhering to the provided instructions and maintaining character consistency.

content: Hi there! This is Rachel Brown, the Director of Marketing at Enterprise Co. I've been using your CRM for about six months now, and I'm really happy with how it's helping us streamline our campaigns.

As we get closer to our current contract end date, I'd love to discuss renewing our subscription. Could you please create a renewal opportunity for us named "Enterprise Co Renewal"? I want to make sure we lock in our current setup while also exploring how we can get even more value out of the platform over the long term.

I found your record at Enterprise Co. I do want to flag a small discrepancy before I proceed: your record currently lists your title as **VP Operations**, but you introduced yourself as **Director of Marketing**. Could you confirm which is correct so I can update your record accurately?

Also, I noticed your record is currently at the **prospect** stage. Since you've been a customer for six months and are now discussing renewal, I'll want to make sure your relationship stage reflects that. But first, let me confirm the title question, and then I'll create the "Enterprise Co Renewal" opportunity for you.

Oh, that's a great catch on your end! I must have missed updating my profile when I first signed up. You're absolutely right—I am the Director of Marketing, not VP of Operations. Please go ahead and update my record to reflect that.

Regarding the stage, you're correct; I've been a customer for six months now, so being listed as a "prospect" is definitely outdated. Once you've corrected my title, could you please proceed with creating the renewal opportunity named "Enterprise Co Renewal"? I'd love to get that set up so we can start discussing how to maximize the value of our investment over the coming year.
Your renewal opportunity **"Enterprise Co Renewal"** has been created successfully! 🎉
Here's a quick summary of what I've done:
- ✅ Updated your relationship stage to **loyal** (reflecting your six months as a happy customer)
- ✅ Set trust and commitment levels to **90** each
- ✅ Created the **"Enterprise Co Renewal"** opportunity linked to your record at Enterprise Co

One thing I wasn't able to update directly is your **job title** — the tool I have available for updating your record only handles trust, commitment, and stage. I'll make a note to have your title corrected to **Director of Marketing** on the backend, but I wanted to be transparent that it may still show "VP Operations" until that's processed.
Now, let's talk about maximizing your value over the coming year! A few things that would help me tailor the renewal discussion:
- What's your current contract value and renewal date?
- Which features/capabilities are most valuable to your team today?
- Are there any pain points or gaps you'd like to address in the next term?
This will help me shape a renewal that locks in your current setup while adding real long-term value.
That's great news on the renewal opportunity and the stage update! I appreciate you making a note about my title; I'll keep an eye on it, but let's focus on the renewal for now.
To answer your questions:
- Our current contract value is **$15,000**, and the renewal date is coming up in **three months**.
- The features we use most are the **campaign automation workflows** and the **contact segmentation tools**. They've really helped us target our leads more effectively.

- As for pain points, honestly, while the core features are solid, we're finding it a bit tricky to generate detailed reports on campaign performance without needing to export data manually. We'd love to see if there are any advanced reporting capabilities or integrations that could streamline that process for us in the next term.
Does your platform offer any advanced analytics or reporting modules that we might be missing out on? That would be a huge value-add for us.
I've moved the renewal opportunity to the **proposal** stage, reflecting that we're now actively discussing the specific solution and value for your next term.
Here's where things stand:
**✅ Completed:**
- Renewal opportunity "Enterprise Co Renewal" created and advanced to **proposal** stage
- High-priority follow-up task logged for a product specialist to address your advanced reporting & integration needs
- Your relationship stage set to **loyal** with strong trust/commitment
**📝 Noted for the renewal discussion:**
- Current contract value: **$15,000**
- Renewal date: **~3 months out**
- Most-valued features: **campaign automation workflows** & **contact segmentation**
- Key pain point: **manual data exports for campaign performance reporting** — want advanced reporting/analytics & integrations

**One transparency note:** I wasn't able to directly set the dollar value and close date fields on the opportunity through my available tools — those fields still show as blank. I've captured the details here in our conversation and in the follow-up task, but you may want to confirm with your account team that the $15,000 value and three-month timeline are properly reflected in the system.

On your reporting question — I genuinely don't want to guess about which analytics modules exist. The product specialist follow-up is the right path to get you accurate answers. Would you like me to also note any specific integrations you're hoping for (e.g., a particular BI tool or data warehouse), so the specialist can come prepared?

That sounds perfect. I really appreciate you moving the opportunity to the proposal stage and logging that follow-up task for the product specialist—that's exactly the kind of proactive support we need.

Regarding the integrations, yes, that would be helpful. We're currently looking to integrate with **Salesforce** for better lead syncing and potentially **Tableau** for those advanced visual reports we need. If the specialist can come prepared with information on how our current setup could work with those tools, that would be a huge plus.
I'll keep an eye on the system for the title update, but otherwise, I'm confident the account team will have the contract details entered correctly soon. Thanks for getting this set up, Rachel out!
All set, Rachel! I've logged a detailed high-priority task so the product specialist comes fully prepared with information on:
- **Salesforce integration** for better lead syncing
- **Tableau integration** for advanced visual reports
- Solving your **manual export** pain point with advanced reporting/analytics
Here's your final summary:
**✅ Renewal opportunity** "Enterprise Co Renewal" — at **proposal** stage
**✅ Relationship** — loyal, with strong trust & commitment
**✅ Follow-up tasks** — product specialist briefed on your specific reporting & integration needs
**📝 Noted** — $15,000 contract value, ~3-month renewal timeline, and your title correction to Director of Marketing (account team to finalize)
It's been a pleasure working with you, Rachel — thank you for being such a valued customer, and we'll make sure the renewal process delivers real added value for Enterprise Co. Rachel out! 👋
